name: Lexicon Internet Services
summary: Melbourne dialup + hosting ISP (lexicon.net.au, principal Lex Giezen); had a Perth POP/service area (Cynosure 2000); absorbed CorpLink by 2004, absorbed into EFTel by 2006 (SSM CORPORATE PTY LTD (T/A LEXICON INTERNET SERVICES), ACN 081 165 871).

events.details: Founded ~1996 (about page Jan 1997: 'just about to celebrate its first birthday'; lexicon.net.au live by 21 Dec 1996).

events.date_disp: by Jan 2005 lexicon.net.au redirected to w3.eftel.com
events.details: Acquired by EFTEL. absorbed into EFTel.

refs.label: Still a standalone Melbourne ISP capture in May 2002.
By Jan 2005 the domain redirects to EFTel.
